title: Marionette in Ritual Chamber
description: A skeletal humanoid figure stands bound in complex black strings and wires, glowing white from within. The figure is positioned in the center of a dark room with melting white walls covered in occult drawings, skulls, and skeletal diagrams, surrounded by scattered tarot cards and a multi-armed candelabra with lit candles.
prompt: A skeletal humanoid figure stands bound in complex black strings and wires, glowing white from within, positioned in the center of a decaying room with melting white walls covered in occult drawings, skulls, and skeletal diagrams. Dark surreal horror scene with dripping paint textures and high contrast black and white aesthetic.
